original_title: Pierre Bourdieu: sociologia
note: The Ática anthology organized by Renato Ortiz, Coleção Grandes Cientistas Sociais. A Portuguese selection, absent from candidates; not another complete French book.

original_title: Histoires figurales: des monstres médiévaux à Wonderwoman
note: Portuguese translation through Immagini e immaginario nella storia; that Italian title is identified bibliographically as the translation of Histoires figurales.

note: A separate article, translated by Anne-Marie Milon Oliveira in 1995. No candidate represents this article; broader cultural-history books are not equivalent.

note: Portuguese translation of The Age of Capital; 1982 is the cited edition.

original_title: Histoire du corps
note: Portuguese edition of the three-volume collective history directed by Corbin, Courtine and Vigarello. All three candidate lists share the same work ID.

note: Portuguese and English titles translate the same 1986 book. The only equivalent candidate is Your money or your life; Le Moyen Âge et l’argent is different.

original_title: El vocabulario de Michel Foucault: un recorrido alfabético por sus temas, conceptos y autores
note: Edgardo Castro’s dictionary, translated into Portuguese by Ingrid Müller Xavier (Autêntica, 2009). No candidates supplied.

note: The truncated candidate title identifies the same article. Do not substitute Visions of Politics, which later collects a revised version.

original_title: A democracia nas urnas: o processo partidário eleitoral brasileiro
note: IUPERJ/Rio Fundo, 1991; study of the 1945–1964 party-electoral system. The author’s candidate list is empty.

note: José Carlos Reis, Ática, 1994. The candidate person is mislabeled José de Oliveira Reis and mixes authors; none of the listed works is this book.

note: Alameda, 2008. Brill’s record for the English translation explicitly confirms the Portuguese original’s title, year and ISBN. Neither candidate matches.

note: Joint book by Cláudia de Oliveira, Mônica Pimenta Velloso and Vera Lins, Garamond/Faperj, 2010. Absent from Velloso’s candidates.

note: Portuguese translation of the 1995 book, published in Brazil in 2002. No candidates supplied; distinct from Education beyond capital.
